newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Ceylon Cold up 4.3 pct on results.
newsitem.headline: Ceylon Cold up 4.3 pct on results.

text.p: shares of Ceylon Cold Stores rose 4.3 percent or 4.75 rupees to 115, on Thursday, brokers said.
"The rise is because retailers are buying the scrip due to its good perfomrnace in the last financial year," said a broker who declined to be identified.
Cold Stores, a unit of John Keells Holdings, saw net profits grow by 73 percent to 152.78 million rupees, in the 12 months ended March 31, 1997.
The company has a large slice of the local market for processed meats and bottled soft drinks.
